I am AGAINST taking abortion away from veterans and their families and support abortion access for all. It is an atrocity to ban all abortion care for veterans and their dependents — even in cases of rape, incest, or to protect the health of the pregnant person. If this rule is finalized as written, veterans and their dependents would be able to get an abortion only if they face imminent risk of death. Women deserve better than being stripped of their vital healthcare. Legalized abortion reduces the risk of unsafe abortions, which can lead to complications, infections, and even death. Denying women access to abortion violates their fundamental right to bodily autonomy and reproductive control. Legal abortion reduces healthcare costs associated with complications from unsafe abortions and improves women's ability to work and contribute to the economy. A majority of Americans support legal abortion, with polls consistently showing that over 60% of adults believe abortion should be legal in all or most cases. When people are denied access to abortion due to criminalisation, restrictive laws and other barriers, their ability to exercise reproductive autonomy and enjoy their human rights is undermined.  

But laws are not the only thing stopping people from seeking abortions.     

Some people are not able to get an abortion because they can’t afford to take time off work for appointments or because they can’t afford to travel to another country or state to receive care. People who need abortions are also confronted by social stigma that makes it difficult for them to exercise their rights. The U.S. Supreme Court has ended the federal constitutional right to abortion — handing our power to control our own bodies to politicians, return our rights to us.It is essential that laws relating to abortion respect, protect and fulfil the human rights of pregnant persons and not force them to seek out unsafe abortions.
